Digital Maturity Program · n8n workflow trigger

Digital Maturity Assessment - Setup

Configure a new maturity assessment, respondents and core activities on a single page. The complete setup is submitted as JSON to n8n.

MATURITY SCALE
1 · Document Driven
2 · System Driven
3 · Data Driven
4 · Predictive Driven
5 · AI Driven
01

Requester

Start typing the name and pick the person from the directory. Email and department are filled in automatically.

About this assessment

Objective. Assess the digital maturity of the department's core processes. The focus is on the process, not the people.

  • Answer based on the current reality.
  • Consider the process end-to-end.
  • Select the most common practice when execution varies.
02

Company

Type the CNPJ of the site being assessed. The company data is looked up automatically; leave it blank if it does not apply.

03

Who will receive the form

Add everyone who should complete the assessment. Names are searched in the directory as well.

04

Core activities to evaluate

Each activity will be scored against all maturity dimensions.

Tip: keep names short and recognizable. Use the description for systems, scope or acronyms.
05

Framework & send

Review the setup and submit it to n8n.
